seeds: replicate i uses numpy default_rng(70000 + i), i = 0..99, at every n (same seeds and draws as e6_calibrations.csv for n = 200, 400)
split: fold 1 = first floor(n/2) rows of each sample (rows are in random order), fold 2 = the rest
rule: reject H_{0,alpha} iff TPR - FPR - sqrt(log(2/delta)/(2 n2)) - sqrt(log(2/delta)/(2 m2)) > alpha, rates on fold 2

classifiers.gbm: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier, default hyperparameters (max_iter=100, learning_rate=0.1, max_leaf_nodes=31), random_state = replicate seed; label X if predicted probability > 0.5 (predict)
classifiers.knn: sklearn KNeighborsClassifier, k = int(sqrt(n1+m1)) | 1 (odd), Euclidean, majority vote
